summary.en: Eel DNA, statistical size analysis, a disputed photograph and a new collection plan answer different questions. None should be substituted for another.
summary.ko: Eel DNA, statistical size analysis, a disputed photograph and a new collection plan answer different questions. None should be substituted for another.

body.en: The eDNA announcement, size analysis, photograph history and follow-up plan each address a different proposition.
body.ko: The eDNA announcement, size analysis, photograph history and follow-up plan each address a different proposition.

body.en: Detection does not establish size, a statistical model does not prove biological impossibility, and a plan is not a research result.

text.en: The research team reported eel DNA but could not determine the animals' size.
